reply.text: This is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess the ache or tell you what it means. What I can do is build your training around it: if you tell me what to avoid and what's been bothering you during training, I'll work that into the program. If you'd like, I can also make the swap from lunges now, so just say the word and I'll put a knee-friendlier option in for that session.
